# GMEOW Email Module

The GMEOW Email Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/email>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/email`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Email messages, threads, mailboxes and body structure — the JMAP (RFC 8621) superset layer, also covering RFC 5322 headers, MIME, IMAP keywords and the Gmail API. Messages are not disjoint from the entities (via EmailAddress) or accounts (via mailbox residence) they involve, and residence is temporally grounded.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/email>
